title: Improving Semantic Coverage in AI Test & Evaluation through Generative Augmentation
title_zh: 通过生成式增强提升人工智能测试与评估的语义覆盖范围

paragraphs.en: 本文提出一种生成式增强方法，通过三个阶段来提升AI测试与评估的语义覆盖范围，从而更准确地评估模型性能。 In test and evaluation (T&E) of AI models, evaluators typically have access only to a held-out test dataset and no knowledge of the training data or its semantic composition. If critical input conditions---such as time-of-day, weather, or scene location---are underrepresented in this test dataset, T&E results can be misleadingly due to this semantic coverage gap. We propose a three-stage generative AI pipeline to detect and fill such semantic gaps without requiring ground-truth labels of these semantics. First, vision-language models (VLMs) perform zero-shot binary labeling of semantic factors, and an embedding-space clustering step identifies which semantics most affect downstream model behavior. Second, diffusion-based image-to-image models transform existing covered images into the underrepresented semantic domain, preserving scene content while augmenting high-level appearance. Third, statistical analysis of the augmented image embeddings verifies that the synthetic imagery improves dataset coverage before it is incorporated. Crucially, the synthetic data is used only to enrich the test set and no model retraining is performed for T&E. We validate the full pipeline on both image classification and object detection under day/night semantic gaps, showing that the augmented test datasets better distinguish models with and without exposure to the missing semantic, thereby yielding T&E conclusions that more closely match those of an ideal, fully covered dataset. Code available at https://github.com/Hashe037/DEDUCE
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出一种生成式增强方法，通过三个阶段提升AI测试与评估的语义覆盖范围，从而更准确地评估模型性能。在AI模型的测试与评估（T&E）中，评估人员通常只能访问预留的测试数据集，而不知道训练数据及其语义构成。 如果关键输入条件——例如一天中的时间、天气或场景位置——在该测试数据集中代表性不足，那么由于这种语义覆盖差距，T&E结果可能会产生误导。 我们提出一个三阶段的生成式AI流程，用于检测并填补此类语义差距，而无需这些语义的地面真相标签。 首先，视觉-语言模型（VLM）对语义因素进行零样本二元标注，并通过嵌入空间聚类步骤识别出哪些语义最影响下游模型行为。 其次，基于扩散的图像到图像模型将现有覆盖充分的图像转换为代表性不足的语义域，在保留场景内容的同时增强高层外观特征。 第三，对增强后的图像嵌入进行统计分析，验证合成图像在纳入数据集之前是否提升了数据集的覆盖范围。 关键在于，合成数据仅用于丰富测试集，T&E过程中不会进行任何模型重新训练。 我们在日/夜语义差距场景下，针对图像分类和物体检测任务验证了整个流程，结果表明，经过增强的测试数据集能更有效地区分是否接触过缺失语义的模型，从而得出更接近理想全覆盖数据集的T&E结论。 代码可在 https://github.com/Hashe037/DEDUCE 获取
